anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Wide-radius convex arc extending smoothly from the dorsal ridge to the anterior-most point of the snout.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Minimal extension with a blunt terminal tip; rostrum is vertically thick and lacks a distinct horizontal extension from the melon.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular dark lesion or indentation located on the mid-lateral flank, consistent with a healed predatory bite or parasite attachment site.
other_distinctive_markers: Darkened ocular region visible anterior to the lateral midpoint; specular light refraction patterns present across the dorsal-lateral surface.
